title: ContinuityOps stream completion signal (BF-PRE-015)
description: Committed by the orchestrator as evidence/slices/<slice>/STREAM_COMPLETE.json on a stream branch to signal the supervisor that a stream is ready for review. Free-text values are Simplified Chinese; machine field names stay English.

candidate_sha.description: 40-hex commit that the completion signal binds to

baseline_sha.description: 40-hex stream baseline the candidate descends from

validation_results.description: One entry per validation command; each carries its command, exit code, wall-clock timestamp, and the evidence path it produced.

time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the command completed

context_remaining.description: Final worker-reported remaining context: percent string or token estimate

preflight_ok.description: Snapshot of the dispatch-time warm-gate verdict. Carries no credential check; no auth material exists in the worker container (D-026/D-027). The authoritative source is the persisted evidence/slices/<slice>/preflight-<taskid>.json, not an issue comment.

warm_fresh.description: Whether lastWarmUtc for the Environment was within the ~10h freshness window at dispatch

last_warm_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the warm stamp at dispatch, or null if the gate re-warmed/failed

context_package_ready.description: Whether the required cross-repo context package was in place at dispatch; 'n/a' when the task needs no upstream material

preflight_evidence_path.description: Path to the persisted warm snapshot written back to the stream branch by the control center
